command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Continue'
$P40='GPU-4f7d4396-9304-d12f-7e9b-7f04d1236fc2'
Write-Output '--- ROLLBACK-BEFORE ---'
& nvidia-smi -i $P40 --query-gpu=uuid,power.limit,enforced.power.limit,power.default_limit,power.min_limit,power.max_limit,temperature.gpu,power.draw --format=csv,noheader 2>&1
Write-Output '--- APPLY-150W ---'
$tmp=[System.IO.Path]::GetTempFileName()
$p=Start-Process -FilePath 'nvidia-smi' -ArgumentList @('-i',$P40,'-pl','150') -NoNewWindow -Wait -PassThru -RedirectStandardOutput "$tmp.o" -RedirectStandardError "$tmp.e"
Write-Output "EXIT=$($p.ExitCode)"
(Get-Content "$tmp.o" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -join "`n"
(Get-Content "$tmp.e" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -join "`n"
Remove-Item "$tmp*" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Write-Output '--- VERIFY-AFTER ---'
& nvidia-smi -i $P40 --query-gpu=uuid,power.limit,enforced.power.limit,power.default_limit,temperature.gpu,power.draw,ecc.errors.uncorrected.volatile.total,ecc.errors.corrected.volatile.total --format=csv,noheader 2>&1
Write-Output '--- RTX-UNTOUCHED ---'
& nvidia-smi -i GPU-6d9ae165-7272-a38c-06b1-7276869e980f --query-gpu=uuid,power.limit,enforced.power.limit,driver_model.current,display_active --format=csv,noheader 2>&1
Write-Output '--- RC ---'
